description: Spacing and relative orientation of the four glucan sites compared with cellulose crystallite geometry
code:
exec(open("_lib.py").read())
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
B=framed("3A8E"); sug=B[B.resn=="BGC"]
sites={s:sug[sug.uchain==s][["px","py","pz"]].values for s in ["E_0","F_0","G_0","F_1"]}
cen={k:v.mean(0) for k,v in sites.items()}
print("=== spacing of the four glucan sites ===")
ks=list(sites)
rows=[]
for i in range(len(ks)):
    for j in range(i+1,len(ks)):
        a,b=ks[i],ks[j]
        d_cen=float(np.linalg.norm(cen[a]-cen[b]))
        d_min=float(cKDTree(sites[a]).query(sites[b])[0].min())
        rows.append(dict(pair=f"{a}-{b}", centroid_sep_A=round(d_cen,1), closest_atoms_A=round(d_min,1)))
S=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("centroid_sep_A"); print(S.to_string(index=False))
S.to_csv("site_spacing.csv",index=False)
adj=S[S.centroid_sep_A<25]
print("\nadjacent (90 deg apart) sites: centroid separation %.1f A, closest heavy atoms %.1f-%.1f A"%(
    adj.centroid_sep_A.mean(), adj.closest_atoms_A.min(), adj.closest_atoms_A.max()))
print("cellulose I-beta reference: chains within a hydrogen-bonded sheet are 8.20 A apart (b axis);")
print("sheets stack 3.90 A apart (200 spacing); cross-sectional area per chain = 31.7 A^2.")
print("ratio of AcsD site spacing to in-sheet chain spacing: %.1f x"%(adj.centroid_sep_A.mean()/8.20))

# angle between the four chains' long axes (are they parallel, as in a crystallite?)
L={}
for k,v in sites.items():
    u=np.linalg.svd(v-v.mean(0),full_matrices=False)[2][0]
    L[k]=u if u[2]>0 else -u
print("\npairwise angle between the glucan long axes (deg):")
ang=pd.DataFrame(index=ks,columns=ks,dtype=float)
for a in ks:
    for b in ks: ang.loc[a,b]=round(float(np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(abs(L[a]@L[b]),0,1)))),1)
print(ang.to_string())
ang.to_csv("site_axis_angles.csv")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.4))
a0=ax[0]
for k,c in zip(ks,["#dd6b20","#2b6cb0","#38a169","#805ad5"]):
    v=sites[k]; a0.scatter(v[:,0],v[:,1],s=14,color=c,label=k)
th=np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,200)
a0.plot(12.5*np.cos(th),12.5*np.sin(th),"k:",lw=.8)
a0.plot(45*np.cos(th),45*np.sin(th),"k-",lw=.8)
a0.set_aspect("equal"); a0.set_xlabel("x (A)"); a0.set_ylabel("y (A)")
a0.set_title("Four glucan sites viewed down the cylinder axis\n(dotted = 25 A inner diameter, solid = 90 A outer)")
a0.legend(fontsize=7)
a1=ax[1]
pairs=S.pair.tolist(); a1.bar(range(len(S)),S.centroid_sep_A,color="#718096")
a1.axhline(8.2,color="#c53030",lw=1.5); a1.text(0.1,9.2,"chain spacing in a cellulose I-beta sheet (8.2 A)",fontsize=8,color="#c53030")
a1.set_xticks(range(len(S))); a1.set_xticklabels(pairs,rotation=45,fontsize=7)
a1.set_ylabel("centroid separation (A)"); a1.set_title("The octamer holds chains far apart,\nnot at crystallite spacing")
a1.grid(alpha=.3,axis="y")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
